subject: [PATCH 07/60] mm/memory-tiers: restrict demotion topology to common memory

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch restricts the demotion topology to common memory by changing various functions in mm/memory-tiers.c to use N_MEMORY_COMMON instead of N_MEMORY. This change aims to prevent nodes outside N_MEMORY_COMMON from being used as generic demotion sources or destinations, and to improve performance by building demotion paths and default DRAM references only from nodes within N_MEMORY_COMMON.
